sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Arshad Jameel Hashmi, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Md. Fahimuddin, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Jehanabad (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 27 of 2023 for the offence registered under sections 341, 323, 498A, 354(a), 506, 34 of the IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act lodged on 24.08.2023 by the informant Shehwar Zarin.
3. Since the opposite party no. 2 has already appeared, let him file counter affidavit in the matter.
4. A copy of the petition shall be handed over to the learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 by the petitioner and the receipt has to be filed by 09.05.2025.

5. List this case on 02.07.2025.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Vijay Singh/-
